title: Global OS dogfood: confirmatory Fisher replication for ω(A)–M1 (H-B2-1n lineage)

y17_source_nodes.honesty: H-B2-1o already ran the first fresh-seed Fisher confirmatory (seeds 40–99) and got CONFIRMED [WEAK]. Y17-1 does NOT re-analyze H-B2-1n exploratory data and does NOT treat H-B2-1o as this mission's result. Y17-1 is an independent Global OS replication of the same pre-registered confirmatory design on a new seed range.

goal_contract.goal: Test whether the exploratory Fisher-combined ω(A)–M1 signal from H-B2-1n replicates on independent (N_DIM, seed) draws under a pre-registered primary Fisher criterion.
goal_contract.success: Produce decision SUPPORTED|REJECTED|INCONCLUSIVE with raw artifacts, null preservation, deterministic verification, and (if keys present) independent provider review; never rewrite Y-17 scientific files.
non_goals: Do not upgrade H-B2-1n verdict from exploratory Fisher
